roadmap.scope: Slice 1 (phase 01): pure claim_domain::authority person rules and a CLI gate entry from local checks (U-OOS-3), gating claim add and the shared sign batch for github:<login> subjects; dispute and withdrawal stay open. Slice 2 (phase 02): v8 repo_authority_checks, read_repo_authority with its recorded-fixture contract test (U-OOS-8), authority verify, a behaviour-neutral sign_permitted refactor, then repo subjects gated in claim add, scrape --sign and claim publish. Slice 3 (phase 03): score_attested, labels, --include-unattested, viewer and search. Slice 4 (phase 04): the review-app share draft only (SA-1). Slice 5 (phase 05): imported candidates kept locally and listed offline.

conventions.paradigm: ADR-007 functional Rust. kind, requirement, classify, the CLI gate entry, hand-off data, labels and score_attested are pure (claim-domain, scoring, scraper-domain, viewer-domain, review-domain). Verbs, the viewer and adapters do I/O only. ADTs over flags (Kind, Requirement, Authority, Unattested reason, PermitBasis, SigningRefusal). No enum arm or function exists only for tests: each lands in the step whose production code first constructs or calls it (ruling M4). Crafter: nw-functional-software-crafter.
conventions.test_paradigm: Acceptance: example-based subprocess runs of the REAL openlore binary over the real DuckDB store, fakes only for GitHub, PDSes and the network index (DISTILL walking-skeleton strategy). Pure core: proptest (256 cases) against the CORE-OOS oracles plus crafter-owned proptests in claim-domain / scoring with state-delta (tests/common/state_delta.rs) over a declared universe; single-example unit tests only with a `// bypass:` reason. Adapters: real DuckDB and recorded GitHub fixtures, never mocked. CLI and HTTP scenarios stay single-example (wiring, not invariants).
conventions.scenario_fns: `<test target>::<fn>`. CLI targets (crates/cli): owner_only_signing (slice 1), owner_only_signing_repos (slices 2 and 5), owner_only_signing_readers (slice 3), owner_only_signing_core (CORE-OOS properties). Review app target (crates/openlore-review-app): owner_only_signing_review_app (SA-1). Target names stay stable (ruling L4). Each step lists every fn it activates, RED driver first. Every #[ignore] fn of the five targets maps to exactly one step; the ACTIVE guards PS-3, PS-7 and IC-5 are named in the steps whose code they protect. regenerate_the_frozen_v7_store_fixture is a fixture regenerator, not a step, and stays ignored. 02-02's driver is a crafter-owned adapter contract test created in that step (U-OOS-8 has no acceptance scenario).
conventions.rider_classes: Each step names one RED driver. Other activations are a secondary driver (new behaviour, RED on activation: un-ignore, see it RED, make it green within the step) or a guard (expected green on activation or already active: record a mutation RED per mutation_red_on_pass).
conventions.core_binding_red: A step binding a CORE-OOS property first lands the production function as a signature stub with a todo!() body, then points the sut_* binding at it, so un-ignoring gives a panic RED, never a compile error (DWD-OOS-10). CORE-OOS-3 and CORE-OOS-4 generate repo rows (Owner, RepoListed), so they stay #[ignore] until the step that first constructs those values in production (02-03 and 02-06, ruling M4); person-tier rows are covered earlier by crafter-owned proptests in claim-domain. A property may move unchanged in name and assertions into crates/claim-domain/tests or crates/scoring/tests.
conventions.test_edit_allow_list: (1) Removing the #[ignore] of a named scenario fn. (2) Replacing a named sut_* todo!() body in owner_only_signing_core.rs with ONE real call plus view mapping. (3) U-OOS-12: one added row in PS-2 (01-03, ruling M6) and one in RA-4 (02-03), built only from existing support/authority.rs vocabulary. (4) Wording pins in support/authority.rs, one-line edits only (DWD-OOS-3). (5) Shipped-suite migration per conventions.shipped_suite_migration and each step's shipped_migrations. (6) U-OOS-9 request-log exclusion in crates/test-support/src/fake_github_accounts.rs. Forbidden otherwise: assertions, oracles, strategies, universe slots, guardrails and test names of the owner_only_signing* targets. A missing vocabulary step stops the step and goes to nw-acceptance-designer. Crafter-owned tests in their own crates (adapter-duckdb, adapter-github contract tests, claim-domain, scoring, xtask synthetic violations) may be added.
conventions.shipped_suite_migration: DISTILL wave-decisions lists the shipped acceptance files the behaviour change breaks. Each is listed in files_to_modify AND in shipped_migrations (file -> allowed change) of the step that introduces the breaking behaviour, so every step ends with the whole cli and review-app suites green. Change types: SEEDED-GIVEN (a Given seeded with authority through support/authority.rs steps, e.g. the_repo_holds_authority_file + given_jeff_verified_authority_of, or a seeded link), NON-GITHUB-SUBJECT (only where the test does not depend on the github: scheme), HELPER-ABSORBED (the shared seeding helper is migrated, the caller file needs no edit unless its own Given signs directly), EXPECTATION (only the DISTILL-named flips: score expectations, IR-16b, CORE-6 re-point, a refused cross-person signature), ONLY-IF-CHANGED (edited only if its outcome actually changes). RED protocol: at RED the crafter runs the full `cargo nextest run -p cli` (and `-p openlore-review-app` where the step touches it); every failing shipped file not in shipped_migrations is added to the commit message with its change type, or stops the step if no allowed change fits.
conventions.transitional_risks: Orchestrator rulings (accepted: the work stays on the oos-deliver branch until every step is done). T1: Required(Repo) assertions are not gated in phase 01 (no observation store before 02-01). From 02-05 every sign goes through sign_permitted; repo subjects get their permit from a named transitional entry inside claim_domain::authority (permit_ungated_repo_t1, crafter's name), called only by the CLI repo branches. 02-06 stops claim add calling it, 02-07 closes T1 for claim add (WS-1..WS-10 migrated), and 02-08 deletes the entry when scrape --sign gates repo candidates: T1 fully closed. T2: unpublished person-subject claims stay publishable without a permit until 02-10 (claim publish gate).
conventions.gate_order: Two entries mint the shared SigningPermit, both inside claim_domain::authority: ADR-089's may_sign (same-request reads), kept byte-for-byte and still the only entry the review app calls; and the CLI entry from local checks (may_sign_from_checks, crafter's name), first built in 01-01 for person subjects, given its 7-day window in 01-04, and its RepoListed basis in 02-06 where a repo-listed permit is first minted. sign_permitted (02-05) and publish_signed_claim(&SigningPermit) (02-10) consume permits; neither mints one.
conventions.sign_sites: Six IdentityPort::sign call sites: claim_add, claim_counter, claim_retract, sign_batch, philosophy_add, identity_link. Five route through sign_permitted in 02-05; identity_link (an identity link is a weightless kind) gets an exempt permit; philosophy_add (philosophy records, not claims) is the only allowlisted site. Six publish_signed_claim callers: claim_publish, claim_add, claim_counter, claim_retract, sign_batch, identity_link, all changed in 02-10.
conventions.migrations: v8 = repo_authority_checks only, in 02-01 (forward-only, idempotent, insert-only, live probe). imported_candidates is v9 in 05-01: v8 can reach users' stores before slice 5 and stores are forward-only (DESIGN and DISTILL wrote 'v8 imported_candidates'; RA-12/RA-12b guardrails count only v7 and v8). Never regenerate the frozen v7 fixture after 02-01.
conventions.arch_rules_note: Each step's arch_rules field names the xtask rules it adds or amends; each ships a synthetic-violation test in xtask and must keep `cargo xtask check-arch` green on the real tree. Criteria state outcomes only (ruling L3).
conventions.test_runs: Feature targets: `cargo nextest run -p cli --test owner_only_signing --test owner_only_signing_repos --test owner_only_signing_readers --test owner_only_signing_core` and `cargo nextest run -p openlore-review-app --test owner_only_signing_review_app`. Every step's green list ends with cargo test for each touched crate, `cargo test -p xtask`, `cargo xtask check-arch`, `cargo nextest run -p cli` and `cargo nextest run -p openlore-review-app` (ruling H1). Scoped crates only, never the workspace.
conventions.done_per_step: A step is done when its scenario fns are un-ignored and green, the active guards (PS-3, PS-7, IC-5) pass, and every command in its green list passes.
conventions.mutation_red_on_pass: A guard green on activation gets a recorded mutation RED: break the named rule in production code, run the guard and show it fails, revert. Rule, failing scenario and revert go in the commit message and the execution log RED phase.
conventions.wording: Labels, refusal fragments, hand-off lines, footers and usage messages are DISTILL pins in tests/acceptance/support/authority.rs (DWD-OOS-3); DELIVER may change a pin only by a one-line edit there.
conventions.exit_codes: A refused signature exits non-zero; candidates are still listed (DWD-OOS-4). Usage mistakes exit 2 (RD-11).
conventions.forge_build_time: Forge 6 (DISTILL R6): 01-01 measures the acceptance build of the five new targets once and records it in the execution log and step notes. No consolidation of owner_only_signing_core in this roadmap (ruling L4); an over-budget result is reported to the orchestrator.
conventions.deferred_rulings: H5 / U-OOS-10: the refusal tally is NOT built (a counter with no production caller is dead code). Deferred: the CLI has no telemetry channel; the review app's existing publish.refused.* counters cover the review app.
conventions.upstream_ids: U-OOS-2 -> 02-07. U-OOS-3 -> 01-01, 01-04, 02-06. U-OOS-8 -> 02-02 (before any repo signing step). U-OOS-9 -> 02-08 and 04-01. U-OOS-10 -> deferred (deferred_rulings). U-OOS-12 -> 01-03 (PS-2 row) and 02-03 (RA-4 --mine row).
